name: OpenMAIC
description: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click
one_liner: A one-click virtual classroom where multiple AI 'teachers and classmates' interact with a student together, instead of just one chatbot answering questions.
buyer: An online tutoring or corporate-training company that wants to sell a more immersive, classroom-like AI learning product instead of a plain chatbot.
business_use_cases: An after-school tutoring startup offers 'AI classroom' sessions where a student debates with AI classmates and gets corrected by an AI teacher, sold as a premium tier.
A corporate L&D team runs onboarding simulations where new hires interact with multiple AI 'colleagues' in realistic scenarios.
A language-learning app adds a group-classroom mode with AI peers so solo learners get conversational practice on demand.

money_ideas.idea: License the platform to tutoring centers and corporate training teams as white-label classroom software.
Sell direct-to-consumer subscriptions for an 'AI classroom' study companion app built on top of it.

steal_this: Pick one exam (SAT, a professional certification) and ship a narrow 'AI study group' product using this as the engine — much easier to sell than a generic classroom.
